北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗微凉，体感 2℃，风力不小，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and cool, feels like 2℃ with noticeable wind. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云 18℃，体感舒适。早晚添衣，注意温差哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and 18℃, feeling comfortable. Mind the day-night temperature difference!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗宜人 15℃，体感舒适，户外活动很棒哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant at 15℃, feeling comfortable. Great for outdoor activities!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗温暖 22℃，体感舒适。湿度适中，记得补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 22℃, feeling comfortable. Humidity is moderate, remember to hydrate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 22℃，体感温暖。湿度稍高，注意防潮和舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm at 22℃. Humidity is a bit high, stay comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云 16℃，体感 14℃，天气微凉，记得添衣哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and 16℃, feels like 14℃. It's a bit cool, remember to add clothes!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗 16℃，体感 14℃，天气舒适，正是出游好时节。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and 16℃, feels like 14℃. The weather is pleasant, a great time for outings!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 12℃，体感 10℃，有点凉，注意保暖防湿哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and 12℃, feels like 10℃. It's a bit cool, stay warm and mind the humidity!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天 15℃，体感 11℃，风力不小，小心着凉哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and 15℃, feels like 11℃ with noticeable wind. Take care not to catch a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗 8℃，体感 5℃，昼夜温差大，早晚添衣哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and 8℃, feels like 5℃. Mind the day-night temperature difference!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾 12℃，体感 11℃，能见度低，出行注意安全！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and 12℃, feels like 11℃. Visibility is low, please travel safely!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感-16℃，风力不小，务必裹严实哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -16℃ with strong winds. Bundle up tight!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感-7℃，风力 3级，气温偏低，多穿点哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like -7℃ with a level 3 wind. It's quite cold, dress warmly!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 16℃，体感 12℃，风力 3级，早晚添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 16℃, feels like 12℃ with a level 3 wind. Remember to add layers in the morning and evening!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗温暖 20℃，体感舒适。风力适中，宜人出行哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and warm at 20℃, feeling comfortable. Moderate wind, pleasant for outings!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 1℃，北风 5级，注意防护和保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy, feels like 1℃ with strong north wind. Take care and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗 2℃，体感-3℃，风力 3级，天气寒冷，注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and 2℃, feels like -3℃ with a level 3 wind. It's cold, mind the wind!
